reason: For a homogeneous vector killed by all opposite simple generators, its positive-Borel adjoint span stays in the positive half. Jacobi moves each f_i past the raising operators, producing only Cartan actions and previously covered terms, so this span is an ideal. Maximality kills it. Weight interpolation and the sign involution handle arbitrary vectors and the negative half. See research/phase-2-catchup-24-step3b-e.md.
